title: F3-Swarm v1.5: Verifier-Guided Heterogeneous Edge-Swarm Inference, Distributed RAM Pooling, and Residual Code Repair for Frugal Agentic Intelligence
description: Official open-source benchmark, reproduction suite, and preprint (TR-2026-F3S-05) for Polybee F3-Swarm v1.5. A 3-tier heterogeneous LLM swarm (Qwen2.5-0.5B, 1.5B, and Coder-3B) achieving 96.7% SOTA accuracy across 30 Portuguese administrative, financial, and programmatic edge operations under strict active RAM limits (< 1.5 GiB in edge). Includes full LaTeX source, vector figures, preprint PDF, physical telemetry, and audited results for Labs 01 to 05.
